welcome: Open or drop an .npy / .npz file to explore its arrays.
operation_failed: Could not complete the operation. Select another array or reopen the file.
computing: Computing in the background. You can still browse other arrays.
path_hint: File path — press Enter to open
sidebar_empty: Open a file to list its arrays.
select_array: Select an array on the left
headline: Explore NumPy arrays in any dimension
intro: Navigate dimensions, inspect values, plot curves and distributions.
enter_subarray: Click a subarray to explore its dimensions
enter_row: Click a row index to open that row
click_detail: Click a cell to read and copy its full content.
non_numeric_plot: This array is not numeric. View its content in Table.
choose_slice: Open a 1D or 2D slice in Table before plotting.
plot_controls: Scroll: zoom X · Shift + scroll: zoom Y · drag: pan
plot_tooltip: Scroll to zoom; Shift for Y. Drag to pan; double-click to reset.
no_finite: The array is empty or has no finite numeric values.
xy_hint: X/Y connects points in array order. Use Table to inspect exact values.
samples: {count} original samples · zoom to inspect the visible data
non_numeric_hist: This array is not numeric. A histogram is unavailable.
approximate: Sampled preview — rare events may be missed
json_depth: Nested too deeply. Copy the full JSON to inspect it.
